summary: Six-panel continuation of Page 1. In the break room, Kreeb's attempt to clear repair space displaces Glorp's personal cracked mug and Pixa's charging setup, while Glorp's laminated sign blocks the outlet Zib needs. Jax's unheated soup is the punch line; each panel isolates the specific people and prop needed for its beat.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Tight on Jax holding his covered soup bowl beside the taped-off microwave. He reads Glorp's new notice: DO NOT PROCESS SOUP AS A GROUP. Keep the established break-room counter, shelf, and outlet relationship; no ensemble crowd in this frame.

PANEL 2 — Two-shot at the shared counter: Kreeb moves Glorp's chipped blue-striped mug to the communal shelf to clear repair space. Glorp catches the move and reaches toward his personal mug. Their dispute is about the mug, not the microwave.

PANEL 3 — Close on Glorp reclaiming and protecting the cracked blue-striped mug. Kreeb, still holding his cleaning cloth, is sincerely surprised. Hold the mug's identifiable crack and stripe; nobody else needs to appear.

PANEL 4 — At the taped-off microwave, Zib lifts one corner of Glorp's fresh laminated notice, revealing the established wall outlet behind it while holding an ordinary diagnostic lead. Glorp turns toward the peeling laminate with his mug still in hand. Keep equipment geometry stable.

PANEL 5 — Pixa arrives with her charging lead and finds the kettle occupying her usual charging spot. Her moved tray is beyond cable reach of the same established outlet. Kreeb sees the cable stop short and recognizes what his rearrangement caused. Only their exchange is in focus.

PANEL 6 — Quiet Jax close-up with his still-covered soup. The sign and cluttered counter are visible behind the bowl; he looks at the blocked work area, retrieves his soup and withdraws. The microwave is still taped off and unusable. End on his reluctant, dry agreement with the sign rather than a group tableau.
